say:1:1511489001:0.source_cn: 你们是谁……？为什么会在我家？

say:2:1511489002:0.text: Don't be afraid, Lanao. These are mages who came to help you.
say:2:1511489002:0.source_cn: 兰奥，别怕，他们是来帮助你的魔法师。

say:3:1511489003:0.text: You've been asleep for days. Your father and I were worried sick.
say:3:1511489003:0.source_cn: 你不知道，你一连睡了好几天，我和你爸爸都担心坏了。

say:4:1511489004:0.text: Days?! No wonder I'm so hungry...
say:4:1511489004:0.source_cn: 好、好几天？！难怪我肚子这么饿……

say:6:1511489005:0.text: I'll make you something delicious right away. Rest a bit longer in the meantime.
say:6:1511489005:0.source_cn: 好孩子，爸爸马上就去准备好吃的，你再休息一会吧。

narration:7:1511489006:1.text: After Lanao eats, you examine him with a bit of magic.
narration:7:1511489006:1.source_cn: 兰奥吃饱之后，你用魔力为他进行了简单的检查
narration:7:1511489006:1.male: After Lanao eats, you examine him with a bit of magic.
narration:7:1511489006:1.female: After Lanao eats, you examine him with a bit of magic.

narration:8:1511489007:1.text: The Hypogean's aura has vanished. He's free of her influence.

narration:9:1511489008:1.text: Looking at Lanao, you can't help but think of Nazrik.
narration:9:1511489008:1.male: Looking at Lanao, you can't help but think of Nazrik.
narration:9:1511489008:1.female: Looking at Lanao, you can't help but think of Nazrik.

narration:10:1511489009:1.text: Aside from the twin tails, could there be more they share? You feel the need to test it.
narration:10:1511489009:1.male: Aside from the twin tails, could there be more they share? You feel the need to test it.
narration:10:1511489009:1.female: Aside from the twin tails, could there be more they share? You feel the need to test it.

say:12:1511489010:1.text: Thank you for helping me. Did you want something?
say:12:1511489010:1.male: Thank you for helping me. Did you want something?
say:12:1511489010:1.female: Thank you for helping me. Did you want something?

choice_prompt:13:1511489010.text: Thank you for helping me. Did you want something?
choice_prompt:13:1511489010.source_cn: <male>哥哥</male><female>姐姐</female>，谢谢你帮了我。有什么事吗？
choice_prompt:13:1511489010.male: Thank you for helping me. Did you want something?
choice_prompt:13:1511489010.female: Thank you for helping me. Did you want something?

say:14:1511489011:1.text: Um... I don't know. Mom says I was just born this way.
say:14:1511489011:1.source_cn: 唔……不知道。妈妈说我天生就是这样。
say:14:1511489011:1.male: Um... I don't know. Mom says I was just born this way.
say:14:1511489011:1.female: Um... I don't know. Mom says I was just born this way.

say:15:1511489012:1.text: Is it weird? I like them! They're fun!
say:15:1511489012:1.source_cn: 很奇怪吗？我还挺喜欢这两条尾巴的呢！它们很有趣！
say:15:1511489012:1.male: Is it weird? I like them! They're fun!
say:15:1511489012:1.female: Is it weird? I like them! They're fun!

choice_prompt:16:1511489012.text: Is it weird? I like them! They're fun!
choice_prompt:16:1511489012.source_cn: 很奇怪吗？我还挺喜欢这两条尾巴的呢！它们很有趣！
choice_prompt:16:1511489012.male: Is it weird? I like them! They're fun!
choice_prompt:16:1511489012.female: Is it weird? I like them! They're fun!

say:17:1511489013:1.text: Two souls? No way! Don't try to trick me!
say:17:1511489013:1.source_cn: 两个灵魂？怎么可能有这样的事！
say:17:1511489013:1.male: Two souls? No way! Don't try to trick me!
say:17:1511489013:1.female: Two souls? No way! Don't try to trick me!

say:19:1511489015:1.text: Unexpectedly, he starts chattering away, full of stories from his daily life.
say:19:1511489015:1.source_cn: 你似乎意外打开了兰奥的话匣子，他叽叽喳喳地讲起了生活中...
say:19:1511489015:1.male: Unexpectedly, he starts chattering away, full of stories from his daily life.
say:19:1511489015:1.female: Unexpectedly, he starts chattering away, full of stories from his daily life.

say:20:1511489016:1.text: The Nazrik you once knew was proud, distant, untouchable. Lanao is nothing like him—he shines with warmth, brightness, and unrestrained life. The contrast stirs a memory of something Dura once said:
say:20:1511489016:1.source_cn: 你认识的那非性格冷傲，兰奥却与他截然不同。这让你想到了...
say:20:1511489016:1.male: The Nazrik you once knew was proud, distant, untouchable. Lanao is nothing like him—he shines with warmth, brightness, and unrestrained life. The contrast stirs a memory of something Dura once said:
say:20:1511489016:1.female: The Nazrik you once knew was proud, distant, untouchable. Lanao is nothing like him—he shines with warmth, brightness, and unrestrained life. The contrast stirs a memory of something Dura once said:

say:21:1511489017:1.text: <style="highlight">When a soul returns to the Tree of Life, even if a new leaf grows in the same place, it will no longer be the same as before.</style>

say:22:1511489018:1.text: So it was with Perseus, beloved of the Hunting Goddess. And so it is with Nazrik, the one you once knew.
say:22:1511489018:1.source_cn: 狩猎神所爱的珀尔修斯如此，你所熟悉的那非亦是如此。
say:22:1511489018:1.male: So it was with Perseus, beloved of the Hunting Goddess. And so it is with Nazrik, the one you once knew.
say:22:1511489018:1.female: So it was with Perseus, beloved of the Hunting Goddess. And so it is with Nazrik, the one you once knew.

say:23:1511489019:1.text: Nazrik and Lanao... two souls born from the same root, yet now wholly different.
say:23:1511489019:1.source_cn: 那非和兰奥，早已是完全不同的两个人。

narration:24:1511489020:0.source_cn: 与此同时，一处隐蔽的丛林里……

choice:16:0:1.text: What if I told you they mean you have two souls?
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 如果我说它意味着你有两个灵魂呢？
choice:16:0:1.male: What if I told you they mean you have two souls?
choice:16:0:1.female: What if I told you they mean you have two souls?

choice:13:0:1.text: Why do you have two tails?
choice:13:0:1.male: Why do you have two tails?
choice:13:0:1.female: Why do you have two tails?
